field 1.title: Fields
field 1.text:
You reach the abyssal canyon once again.

Lucid: [We're here again. After that incident, the manager told me stories about various things in and around the canyon that... have never been seen anywhere else.]

Pemmi: [Like new species?]

Lucid: [No. Things that are... strange. It's hard to explain. We should be as careful as possible.]

You tell him how you had crossed the canyon when you first came here.

Lucid: [Using the rope? We know the canyon is full of unknown danger. We'll find another way to cross.]

You go back to the woodcutters' village near the canyon.

Villager: [The crevice? The bridge isn't done. Some people tried to cross it using a shifty air boat but it didn't work. They left it here, if you want to give it a try.]

The villager leads you to an old building, and you see a rather crude air boat inside.

Lucid: [This air boat was modified to utilize mana instead of Jericho's power field. I'm guessing it failed because it requires too much mana.]

Lucid: [But... if Cheese uses his amulet to provide mana for the boat, he could take us to the other side one by one.]

You drag the boat out and Cheese takes each of you one by one across the canyon.

Cheese: [This is pain... This is torture...]

You leave the vomit stained air boat behind and continue the journey.

field 2.title: Fields
field 2.text:
You travel back to Stone Henge over a week.
The monsters that you had fought on your way to Jericho are no match for all of you.

henge help.title: Stone Henge
henge help.text:
Lucid: [Alright, we're nearing Stone Henge.]

Bigs: [What's our plan?]

Lucid: [We'll march in and request meeting with the priest. They won't harm us if we show up in numbers and heavily armed.]

You march into Stone Henge and stop before the guard outpost.
The Stone Henge guards are on full alert, and the move about busily in the distance.

Pemmi: [I'll go alone.]

Pemmi walks into Stone Henge.
A few guards come out and escort her inside.

You wait.

henge help 2.title: Stone Henge
henge help 2.text:
Half an hour later, Pemmi and the priest walks out, escorted by several guards.

Pemmi: [Our priest agreed to accept help and fight the spiders.]

Pemmi leads your group into the temple.

Priest: [I... apologize for what had happened. We did what we thought was best. If you'd help us, Stone Henge shall attempt to be free once again.]

Priest: [I will now gather all residents of Stone Henge and declare a state of emergency against the horned spiders. Do you have any questions?]

opt.text: How did it come to be this way?

ask henge.title: Stone Henge
ask henge.text:
Priest: [It started 5 years ago. Those wretched horned spiders came from nowhere and started preying upon our people. We slowly lost our valuable hunters to their cunning ambushes... Stone Henge was bleeding dry. Without our hunters, we can't defend nor feed ourselves.]

Priest: [So we tried to offer various meats to the spiders in hopes of reducing our hunter casualties, but the spiders seemed only interested in live humans.]

Lucid: [We had found some feral humans living deep inside one of the spider nests. They had a whole village going, but they didn't speak our language. Maybe the spiders were abducting people and putting them in their nests to, maybe farm us?]

Priest: [The ferals showed up when the spiders first showed up. The kidnapping only started 5 years ago, so I highly doubt the ferals are victims of abduction. Have you found any of our people in the den?]

Lucid: [No, we found Sugar, a hunter from Ant Hill. He said that everyone else had died trying to break out.]

henge help 2-1.title: Stone Henge
henge help 2-1.text:
Lucid: [Very good. Let's put our conflicts behind us and work together to drive the spiders out of Stone Henge. We have brought powerful weapons from Jericho, strong enough to down a spider in a single volley.]

Priest: [Thank you, Lucid. To be honest, when I first met you, I was a bit skeptical about your motives. I hope you found what you were looking for.]

Lucid: [I did not, but there are more important things in this world. Let us work together and rid the abominations from the frontier.]

The priest invites you all to watch him declare a state of emergency and distribute muskets to the finest hunters of Stone Henge.
Most people in Stone Henge seems to have no idea what had been happening.

Bigs: [We'll need a day to familiarize your hunters with the muskets.]

Priest: [Then we should strike in two days. We can't give the spiders much time to prepare.]

henge help 2-2.title: Stone Henge
henge help 2-2.text:
Lucid: [Very good. Let's put our conflicts behind us and work together to drive the spiders out of Stone Henge.]

Priest: [Thank you, Lucid. To be honest, when I first met you, I was a bit skeptical about your motives. I hope you found what you were looking for.]

Lucid: [I did not, but there are more important things in this world. Let us work together and rid the abominations from the frontier.]

The priest invites you all to watch him declare a state of emergency.
Most people in Stone Henge seems to have no idea what had been happening.

Bigs: [Alright. We'll make our preparations. When are we moving?]

Lucid: [The priest wants to move out in two days. The spiders probably know of your coming, and we shouldn't give them much time to prepare.]

stone henge.title: Stone Henge
stone henge.text:
You are at Stone Henge.
The streets are bustling with people buying rations and weapons.
The gardens outside Stone Henge has turned into a training ground.

henge leave.title: Stone Henge Temple
henge leave.text:
You pack up and leave Stone Henge.
Just as you leave the building, the priest calls you.

Priest: [Wait! You've done me great service, even when I had failed you as a human being. Please, accept this...]

henge fight.title: Stone Henge
henge fight.text:
You visit Pemmi at the training grounds.

Pemmi: [Are you ready?]

henge fight ask.title: Stone Henge
henge fight ask.text:
Pemmi: [There will be four different offense groups. The first group is Lucid, Bigs, and all of the adventurers from Jericho.]

Pemmi: [The second and third group are all made of the best hunters from Stone Henge. You, me, and Cheese belong to the last group. Our role is to wait by the spider forest and report and intercept any movements toward Stone Henge.]

henge fight 2.title: Stone Henge
henge fight 2.text:
You wait for everyone to arrive on the training grounds.

Cheese: [Where's Lucid?]

Pemmi: [All the other groups have departed earlier, Cheese.]

Pemmi: [We are heading out now, hopefully the spiders are distracted from the previous groups.]

You, Pemmi, Cheese, and three Stone Henge guards march on to the spider forest where the feral cave was located.

Pemmi: [We wait here now.]

henge fight 3.title: Stone Henge
henge fight 3.text:
You wait.

Pemmi: [Look, there's several of them over there. We need to dispatch them before they get to Stone Henge!]

henge fight 4.title: Stone Henge
henge fight 4.text:
Pemmi: [Are you ok? Let's heal up and keep waiting.]

You continue hiding for ambushes.

Cheese: [I see one, over there.]

Pemmi: [Same plan, let's go!]

henge fight 5.title: Stone Henge
henge fight 5.text:
You heal up and wait some more.

Guard: [It's getting dark. We need to go back.]

Pemmi: [Lucid hasn't come back from the nest... We should go check up on them in the nest before we leave.]

opt.text: Let's go check up on them

henge fight 6.title: Stone Henge
henge fight 6.text:
You move deeper into the forest.
You hear howling sounds from the trees.

Pemmi: [They're on the trees!]

Cheese casts fireball on the tree.

Pemmi: [Cheese, stop! Don't set the forest on fire!]

Guard: [There's more here, come!]

henge fight 7.title: Stone Henge
henge fight 7.text:
You move deeper into the forest into the nest.
The nest is packed with spider carcasses.

Cheese: [Holy grandma of god, that's a lot of spiders.]

Lucid: [Cheese? What are you doing here?]

Pemmi: [It's getting dark and I didn't see you come out, so we were worried.]

Lucid: [Everything is going according to plan here. Bigs just wanted more time exploring the ancient mines. Go back to town, we'll be there shortly.]

You return to Stone Henge.

henge done.title: Stone Henge
henge done.text:
The priest and the residents of Stone Henge welcome you with open arms.

Priest: [Pemmi! Looks like most of our hunters have come back successful from the raid. Where is Lucid and Bigs? Ah, there's Lucid.]

Lucid: [Hello, it looks like everything has gone according to plan. Marvelous!]

Priest: [Hello, Lucid. Where is Bigs and the adventurers?]

Lucid: [They... decided to explore the ancient mines for a bit longer. Bigs said that his work was done here, and he'll return to Jericho after looting the mines.]

Cheese: [What? What about Ant Hill?]

Lucid: [I'm sorry...]

Cheese: [Son of a bitch!]

Priest: [We will send the best of our hunters to Ant Hill as soon as we are done, I promise.]

Lucid: [When do you think you can send help to Ant Hill?]

Priest: [Our hunters tell me that there are still threatening number of spiders around. I would say a week.]

Lucid: [Do you think you still need us?]

Priest: [Honestly, the problem is that we don't know where the spiders are. We've cleared out known locations, and I can only hope that was all of them. We've dealt with what little retaliation that they attempted, so I think we are good on our own now. Help Ant Hill.]

field 3.title: Fields
field 3.text:
Lucid: [Well, we don't have anything to offer Stone Henge. I'll go in and get some supplies.]

Lucid comes back from Stone Henge with food and medical supplies, and you continue on to Ant Hill.

Lucid: [Alright, are we ready to head to Ant Hill?]

Pemmi: [I... want to stay in Stone Henge for now. The last two weeks were too bizarre for me. I want help clean up the mess here.]

Lucid: [Understandable. Take care, Pemmi. I'll see you soon.]

field 4.title: Ant Hill Outskirts
field 4.text:
You travel for days across the fields and forest, cross the river, and now you are nearing Ant Hill.

Lucid: [So how was Ant Hill when you left?]

You explain to him the situation on Ant Hill in detail.

Lucid: [I'm sorry to hear that about your father, Cheese.]

Cheese: [Nah, he tried to kill me. I wouldn't care if he died.]

Lucid: [...]

You finally reach Ant Hill.
In the distance you see the familiar Ant Hill mound where you grew up.

ant hill 1.title: Ant Hill
ant hill 1.text:
The streets of Ant Hill are in ruins.
The wood on vendor shops are rotten, leather and carpets are molded, and there are dried blood splatters all over the streets.
You look around the derelict buildings that you once had fond memories of.

Lucid: [It looks like they're still inside the mound. If they've never left since the time you left Ant Hill, I'm afraid they must have run out of food long ago.]

ant hill 2.title: Ant Hill Underground
ant hill 2.text:
You enter the pitch black darkness of the deeply familiar underground Ant Hill.
Once your home, this place is now reeking of blood.
Further in, Lucid's spell light unveils spots of blood on the surface of the entrance tunnel.

Lucid: [...]

You continue going in deeper, but there are no signs of Sugar or any of the guards.
You move into upper dormitory tunnels.
This time, Lucid's spell light unveils a horned spider.

Cheese: [Spider!]

Lucid: [They're behind us, too. This is an ambush. Be ready!]

ant hill 3.title: Ant Hill Underground
ant hill 3.text:
Cheese: [FUCK!!! IS EVERYONE FUCKING DEAD?!]

Lucid: [Keep quiet, Cheese! There were no spiders outside, there can't be that many inside. Let's continue.]

You hear a shout from down the halls.

Lucid: [That sounds like someone shouting for help. Let's go!]

You run towards the shouting, and the spell light unveils yet more spiders in the darkness.

ant hill 4.title: Ant Hill Underground
ant hill 4.text:
You kill the spiders, and someone comes out from the shadows.

???: [My god... is that you?]

It is Sugar.
He is missing his left arm, covered in dirt and blood, and reeks with stench.

Sugar: [Hurry, come inside.]

Sugar leads you into the temple and sets up a wooden barricade.

Sugar: [I heard you fighting outside and screamed for help. I can't believe you made it in here... Is it safe outside?]

Lucid: [We don't know, Sugar. You and these five hunters are all that's left of Ant Hill?]

Sugar: [There are about twenty people deeper down in the lower dormitory tunnels. They're in a safe place with the remaining supplies. We came up to try to fight our way out... and got trapped here. We were just starting to run out of that god forsaken spider meat...]

Cheese: [First human meat, and now spider meat. Cruel fate.]

Sugar: [Cheese. I swore to myself I'd pluck out your eyes the next time I see you... but I can't believe I'm actually glad to see you here. Also, your dad died.]

Cheese: [...Where is Cobby?]

Sugar: [I killed him. He was a traitor to our people.]

Cheese: [Fuck you! You are an unbearable moron!]

Lucid: [...Enough fighting, let's focus on our common enemy. We'll help you clear the way out. After we secure the way out, we should move to Stone Henge with the remaining people down there.]

Sugar: [It's pitiful, but we are not in good shape to fight. We'll help, but we'll be of little use.]

ant hill 5.title: Ant Hill Underground
ant hill 5.text:
You are scouting underground Ant Hill for any remaining horned spiders.

You need to scout five locations in total: Upper dormitory tunnels, lower dormitory tunnels, storage tunnels, garden tunnels, and the entrance tunnels.

opt.to: >custom>You scout the entrance tunnels and the guards' dormitory.>>encounter>horned spider>@defeat>>save>quest>2>@ant hill 5

>custom>You scout the garden tunnels.
The entire garden area is bright greenish yellow with glowing mushrooms growing rampant.
It seems to be safe.>>save>quest>3>@ant hill 5
>custom>You scout the upper dormitory tunnels.>>encounter>three horned spiders>@defeat>>save>quest>4>@ant hill 5

ant hill lower dorm.title: Ant Hill Underground
ant hill lower dorm.text:
You scout the lower dormitory tunnels and the waste storage tunnels.
It reeks of blood and feces.

You run into a heavily barricaded door.

Lucid: [This must be where the residents are hiding. Better not to bother them until we've secured the place.]

ant hill storage.title: Ant Hill Underground
ant hill storage.text:
You enter the storage tunnels.
There are destroyed wooden barricades and furniture everywhere.

Lucid: [Looks like this place was looted for food by the spiders after supplies were taken out by the residents. Let's search for any remaining supplies.]

ant hill 6.title: Ant Hill Underground
ant hill 6.text:
Lucid: [Alright, it seems the tunnels are safe.]

Sugar: [But are the streets clear?]

Lucid: [We didn't run into anything on the way here. The more time we spend in here, the more chance of them coming back to Ant Hill. I recommend that we move to Stone Henge as soon as possible.]

Sugar: [You're right... Let's get the hell outta here.]

You gather up all the residents from the secure tunnels and bring them up to the entrance.
You leave the residents inside go outside.

ant hill 7.title: Ant Hill
ant hill 7.text:
You stand on the mound and look around the ruined streets.

There are numerous shadows moving behind vendor shops.
You look more carefully.
On a closer look, you realize all those shadows are horned spiders!
Terrifying howling fill the air.

Sugar: [Inside! INSIDE!!]

You lock the gate and hurry back inside.

Sugar: [Hell... They've trapped us all... Just like in the feral caves... Except.. this time there is no way out.]

ant hill 8.title: Ant Hill Underground
ant hill 8.text:
You barricade the entrance and gather up what little supplies are left.
A sense of doom dominate the atmosphere.

Lucid: [We're going to be here for a long time. We should start butchering the spiders for meat. Stone Henge promised to send the best of their hunters to Ant Hill in a week...]

Sugar: [No chance. There's like... a hundred out there. I don't know how you think Stone Henge has won the fight, but they definitely didn't fight THAT many spiders.]

Sugar charges at Cheese.
Cheese stuns her and runs to the entrance.

Sugar: [Cheese... please... I gotta get outta here. I'm going insane!]

Cheese leaves.
You run outside, and watch him float away above the hordes of spiders.
He does not come back.

ant hill 9.title: Ant Hill Underground
ant hill 9.text:
You spend the next few days in the underground Ant Hill.

Not being able to see the sun, drinking stale glowing mushroom wine, and eating nauseous spider meat has taken toll on your sanity and health.

---

You sit on the bed of your old dormitory with Lucid.
He seems to be lost in thought.

The whole situation drives you mad.
You sit and reminisce about when you used to sit on this bed and chat with your roommates.

You subconsciously take out an amulet from around your neck and hold it in your hands.

Lucid: [That's a strange amulet. I haven't seen it before.]

ant hill 10.title: Ant Hill Underground
ant hill 10.text:
Lucid: [You don't... remember having that amulet? Can I see it?]

Lucid takes a careful look at the amulet.

Lucid: [When do you last remember having it?]

You tell him that you last remember having it near the abyssal canyon.

Lucid: [The canyon... The spiders... Could this be... The amulet of will?]

ant hill 11.title: Ant Hill Underground
ant hill 11.text:
Lucid stares at your amulet.

Lucid: [Have I told you my reasons for being in the frontier? I was sent by the Guild of Retrieval to look for a very precious timeless artifact... An amulet said to grant the user the power to turn their will into reality. Do you have any peculiar memories or knowledge since you've obtained this amulet?]

ant hill 12.title: Ant Hill Underground
ant hill 12.text:
Lucid: [It's probably that you can't tell yet, since you obtained the amulet rather recently. Let me test something. Hide this gold coin in one of your pockets while I turn around.]

You hide the coin in your left pocket.

Lucid presses the amulet.

Lucid: [The coin is in your left pocket.]

You continue hiding the coin in various places, but Lucid finds it every time.

Lucid: [This amulet... explains how we all survived countless life threatening situations. This amulet will not only help us get out of here, but may also be the key to saving the frontier from the spiders.]

Lucid hands you back your amulet.

Lucid: [The scholars at the Guild of Retrieval had concluded that the amulet of will grants the user such power through the manipulation of time. Whenever you wish to turn back time, you rub the amulet... and voila, you are back to the turn point of time in which you can change things again.]

opt.text: Can we travel in time then?

ant hill 13.title: Ant Hill Underground
ant hill 13.text:
Lucid: [It doesn't work like that. This amulet may manipulate time, but it's limited by the memory of its user.]

Lucid: [The amulet is powerful indeed, but it has it's limits. We can't take out hundreds of spiders no matter how many times we turn back time. We'll use it to get out of here... But you need to promise me to let me destroy this thing. The Guild of Retrieval have long declared this amulet a threat to mankind.]

ant hill 14.title: Ant Hill Underground
ant hill 14.text:
You are at underground Ant Hill.

Lucid: [Use your amulet here. You will lead us out at the best timing. Remember, if the spiders seem too hard, use the amulet and try another day.]

ant hill out.title: Ant Hill
ant hill out.text:
You and the hunters lead the residents out of underground to the surface.

Lucid: [Sugar and I can guard the sides. Pemmi, can you guard the rear?]

Pemmi: [Ok.]

The spiders howl loudly, warning their allies nearby.

ant hill out 2.title: Fields
ant hill out 2.text:
Pemmi: [We made it out! Let's get to Stone Henge as fast as possible!]

The size of your group constantly attracts horned spiders, but you use your amulet to miraculously maneuver around them.

stone henge refuge.title: Stone Henge
stone henge refuge.text:
You arrive at Stone Henge.
The priest and the guards take you in.

Priest: [This is a great tragedy... Let them take refuge here. Lucid, Pemmi, and you, please follow me to the temple.]

The exhausted refuges and hunters from Ant Hill are escorted inside.
You, Pemmi, and Lucid follow the priest to the temple.

Lucid: [We were trapped inside by the spiders. There were at least a hundred of them at Ant Hill.]

Priest: [A hundred? At Ant Hill?]

Lucid: [I was afraid that Stone Henge was decimated by them. Were you not attacked since we left?]

Priest: [No. I had hoped that we had drove them out completely... But it looks like they were just taking their time. I fear the worst for us all.]

Lucid: [It's too early to give up hope. I will travel to Jericho and get help one last time.]

Priest: [Lucid, you've done so much for all of us. But I don't think there are any way out of this. You do what you wish. I will defend Stone Henge to my last breath, and never let them take away our dignity again.]

stone henge refuge 2.title: Fields
stone henge refuge 2.text:
You leave the temple.

Lucid: [Come on, there is no time to lose. Let's continue on to Jericho. The Guild of Retrieval will surely help us if I show them this amulet.]

You and Lucid are both exhausted from days of traveling from Ant Hill, but you two continue on to Jericho after a brief respite at Stone Henge.

stone henge refuge 3.title: Fields
stone henge refuge 3.text:
You travel for several days, and arrive at the abyssal canyon.

Lucid: [See those weird creatures near the canyon? Remember the dreadful vines in the canyons, we've got to be extra alert.]

Some of the creatures notice you and rush towards you.

final canyon.title: Fields
final canyon.text:
You take down the raptors and move closer to the canyon.
You notice that there is a vast field of dirt and sand on the other side, instead of green grass like you've seen last time.

Lucid: [Something's not right...]

You walk toward the bridge.
A chain of strange, floating smooth metal cylinders connect the two land masses across the bottomless canyon.

Lucid: [A stepping stone of some sort? This... How are these things floating? Who made these?]

Lucid: [I will attempt to cross these metal steps. If anything goes wrong, use your amulet for me.]

Lucid crosses the canyon using the steps.
Strange sounds echo from deep in the bottomless canyon.

Lucid makes it to the other side and waves his hand.
You follow.

final canyon 2.title: Desert
final canyon 2.text:
You walk across the vast desert on the other side of the canyon.

Lucid: [A vast desert... No trees whatsoever. Is it possible that we got lost on the way here? No, that can't be. We followed the map. There is no desert like this around here.]

You continue moving east.

Lucid: [That... is that the woodcutters' village?]

In the middle of the desert, you see couple derelict buildings.
Upon closer inspection, it looks like the buildings were abandoned long ago.

Lucid: [These buildings look like they've been abandoned long time ago... This should be the woodcutters' village according to our map.]

You drag your exhausted legs and continue on to Jericho.
The blazing sun above fries your skin.

Lucid: [Look, a small cliff. We should take shelter from the sun and move at night.]

You sit under the shades by the small rocky cliff until sundown.

Lucid: [Sun's down low. Let's move out.]

final canyon 3.title: Desert
final canyon 3.text:
Lucid: [We should be at the cliff and the Jericho waterfall soon, since we came straight east from the canyon.]

You find the Jericho river dried up into a shallow canyon that could easily be climbed across.

Lucid: [...Let's continue on to Jericho.]

You soon reach the grand cliff surrounding the desert lowlands.
In the distance you see what must be Jericho... or ruins of Jericho.

Lucid: [...No!]

You see weird creatures roaming the vast fields surrounding Jericho.

final canyon 4.title: Desert
final canyon 4.text:
It takes a bit for Lucid to pull himself together.

Lucid: [I see the great tower... That IS Jericho, there is no doubt about it. Did we... cross time when we crossed the fissure? Let's go back.]

final canyon 5.title: Canyon
final canyon 5.text:
You travel back to the canyon.

The green fields on the other side of the canyon greet you.

Lucid: [See this unnatural difference between biomes? This fissure must be not only a fissure in space, but also in time. I don't know how I'm going to go back to old Jericho now...]

You and Lucid cross the canyon using the metal steps.
The soft grass under your feet makes you feel safe again.

final canyon 6.title: Canyon
final canyon 6.text:
Lucid does not respond.
You look at him and notice that he is staring back at the other side of the canyon with his mouth half open.

You turn around.

The vast desert on the other side of the canyon is nowhere to be seen.
Instead, you see a great wall of unnatural darkness along the canyon.

You freeze in place.

Strange sounds echo from the darkness...
Strange flying creatures emerge.
They are things of nightmares... pale, veiny flesh with multiple eyes and wings and covered with blood red veins.
The flying creatures pour out of the darkness and fill the skies.

Lucid grabs you and jumps down the canyon.

final canyon 7.title: Abyss
final canyon 7.text:
You land on a small ledge with the sound of your bones being crushed.
It is pitch black.

Lucid: [Are you... ok?]

You hear the thundering sounds of thousands of wings flapping wildly above the canyon.

Lucid: [The fissure... It shifted in time again... The amulet of will... It ruined us.]

final canyon 8.title: Abyss
final canyon 8.text:
You subconsciously take out the amulet.

This situation feels somehow familiar...
Suddenly, you remember the voice at the bottom of the abyss, how you obtained the amulet in the first place.

And now you know the only way to get rid of this cursed amulet.

final canyon 9.title: Abyss
final canyon 9.text:
You stand up.
You try not to scream as the broken bones in your ribs pierce you from the inside.

Lucid: [It's over...]

You stumble away from dying Lucid.

You descend further down into the abyss...

ant hill neutral.title: Ant Hill Underground
ant hill neutral.text:
You spend the next few days in the underground Ant Hill.
Not being able to see the sun, drinking stale glowing mushroom wine, and eating nauseous spider meat has taken some toll on your sanity and health.

You sit on the bed of your old dormitory with Lucid.

Lucid: [The whole thing doesn't make sense. Where did they come from? How did no one ever even witness them while they grew in such incredible numbers?]

The whole situation drives you mad.
You sit and think about when you used to sit on this bed and chat with your roommates.

One of the guards come into the room.

Guard: [I haven't seen any spiders outside for the last two days.]

Lucid: [Then we should make a move. We are going to lose all hope before we run out of supplies.]

ant hill neutral 2.title: Ant Hill
ant hill neutral 2.text:
You walk to the gates with Lucid.

The ruined streets of Ant Hill are completely still... No signs of spiders.
Lucid turns into a mouse.
He crawls through the gates and skitters out onto the streets.

Few minutes later, he comes back.

Lucid: [I think it's safe. They're all gone.]

You go back inside and tell Sugar.

Sugar: [I... I don't know... Ok... I'll follow...]

Guard: [He's been out of his mind for the last couple days.]

You gather up all the remaining residents of Ant Hill and prepare for a journey to Stone Henge.

ant hill neutral 3.title: Fields
ant hill neutral 3.text:
You lead your group of desperate residents toward the woods.

Lucid: [What... happened here?]

The Ant Hill woods are burnt down.
There are few greenery left among the vast fields of ash and burnt woods.

Lucid: [Some kind of... forest fire?]

You continue on to Stone Henge.
It seemed the forest fire destroyed almost all of the forest on the way.

ant hill neutral 4.title: Stone Henge
ant hill neutral 4.text:
You reach Stone Henge with the exhausted group of refugees.
The guards of Stone Henge lead your group to the training grounds.

Guard: [Please wait here, we will bring out food and medical supplies.]

Soon after, the priest of Stone Henge comes running out along with Pemmi.

Priest: [What happened?]

Lucid: [Ant Hill was attacked. This is what's remaining of Ant Hill. What is going on with the burnt woods?]

Pemmi: [It's... Cheese. He went around setting everything on fire...]

Lucid: [Oh, my.]

Pemmi: [Well... we first thought it was a bad thing. But it looks like he destroyed most of the horned spiders' habitats. We think the spiders have fled Stone Henge to a more habitable location.]

You and Lucid are completely dumbfounded.

Lucid: [I... guess the spiders couldn't attack him in the air...]

ant hill neutral 5.title: Stone Henge
ant hill neutral 5.text:
Priest: [It looks like it, since the spiders can't live off of barren land. But neither can we. We should find Cheese and stop his rampage.]

Lucid: [Hmm. I don't think Cheese can survive on his own for long. He'll sooner or later have to come back for food.]

opt.text: Wait in Stone Henge for Cheese

ant hill neutral 6.title: Stone Henge
ant hill neutral 6.text:
You settle in Stone Henge for the time being.

The exhausted refugees from Ant Hill have integrated into Stone Henge.
You make a living by hunting for food from places not yet destroyed by forest fire.

ant hill neutral 7.title: Dolomite Tavern
ant hill neutral 7.text:
A week passed.

You huddle into Dolomite tavern with your friends after a successful hunting session.

Barkeep: [Hey ya! The greatest hunter from Ant Hill! What can I get ya?]

ant hill neutral 8.title: Dolomite Tavern
ant hill neutral 8.text:
It's delicious! You eat the whole thing in seconds.

Pemmi: [You're starting to eat like Cobby!]

You take her milk pudding and shove it in your mouth.
Pemmi laughs.

Barkeep: [Who's that?]

A pale teenager stumbles into the tavern, looking completely exhausted and frail.

Cheese: [F..Foood...]

Pemmi: [There he is.]

ant hill good.title: Ant Hill
ant hill good.text:
You try to enter the deeply familiar underground Ant Hill, only to be obstructed by heavy fortification.

You knock on the wooden barricade.
You can hear some shuffling inside.

???: [Hello?]

ant hill good 2.title: Ant Hill Underground
ant hill good 2.text:
???: [Oh.]

It takes them a while to take down the barricades.

Cobby: [You made it again! Come in quick, we need to put the barricades back up.]

You enter the dark underground Ant Hill as Cobby and the guards put up the barricade behind you.

ant hill good 3.title: Ant Hill Underground
ant hill good 3.text:
Cobby: [Well... There's been a fight. The priest wanted peaceful surrender, but Sugar insisted on executing most of us. So we holed up again.]

Cobby: [Eventually, some of his followers got frustrated with the way he handled things. They kicked Sugar out of leadership and went marching against the spiders... and died.]

Lucid: [...]

Cobby: [Yeah... In hindsight, I'm glad we didn't end up surrendering to those reckless idiots.]

Cobby: [But anyways, the spiders are still out there, and now they're even angrier.]

ant hill good 4.title: Ant Hill Underground
ant hill good 4.text:
Someone approaches from the darkness.

Priest: [Cheese? Is that you?]

Cheese freezes.

Cheese: [Dad.]

Priest: [Cheese! I...]

[Dad. Did you try to kill me?]

Everyone stands silently.
You can feel the fascination in people's faces.
The priest's affairs are one of the greatest gossips in Ant Hill.

Priest: [I'm sorry Cheese, but I couldn't put my personal values before Ant Hill.]

Cheese: [For Ant Hill? more like for HORNED SPIDERS!]

Cheese runs out towards the gates.
People murmur and gossip quietly.
Lucid chases after Cheese.

ant hill good 5.title: Ant Hill Underground
ant hill good 5.text:
A moment later, Lucid comes back down from the surface.

Lucid: [He floated away.]

Priest: [Floated away?]

You explain what has become of Cheese.
The priest seems to have lost his words.

Cobby: [Interesting... Anyways, let's get to the temple. We're going to have a meeting to observe our options now.]

As you head to the temple, the priest stops you.

Priest: [I haven't thanked you properly last time. I don't know how you obtained this sigil, but I will give it back to you now.]

ant hill good 6.title: Ant Hill Underground
ant hill good 6.text:
Priest: [Also... Can you... No, Cheese will be safe. He seems much stronger now. You have not only kept him safe, but made him stronger. I cannot ever repay you for what you've done for Cheese. Thank you.]

---

The meeting was rather short.

Priest: [So, it is decided that we will wait here for reinforcement from Stone Henge. In the meantime, we will send our elite hunters out to delay our food shortages. If we take rations, we should be able to last more than a week.]

ant hill good 7.title: Ant Hill Underground
ant hill good 7.text:
It is the next day.

Cobby takes you and 2 other hunters out for hunting.

Cobby: [We hunt as stealthy as possible. We'll butcher on the spot and wrap the meat in cloth so we don't attract the spiders' attention.]

You get to the Ant Hill woods and find the whole forest burnt down.

Cobby: [What the hell happened here?]

You find some burnt beetle carcass, butcher it and bring it to Ant Hill.

ant hill good 8.title: Ant Hill Underground
ant hill good 8.text:
You spend the next couple days as a hunter, providing food for Ant Hill.

You are treated with respect and seen with envy as one of the few elite hunters left in Ant Hill.
Even Cobby admits that you've become one of the best hunters he's known.

Spiders have stopped showing up around Ant Hill, and the people of Ant Hill return to the surface.

The week passes.

Hunters from Stone Henge arrive.

ant hill good 9.title: Ant Hill Underground
ant hill good 9.text:
Lucid: [I'm glad Stone Henge sent us help as promised. Is Pemmi with you?]

Stone Henge hunter: [Pemmi decided to stay back in Stone Henge.]

Lucid: [Oh... ok.]

Stone Henge hunter: [Looks like the entire forest around here is burnt down. Are you still being attacked by horned spiders?]

Priest: [We haven't seen spiders around Ant Hill since the burning down of the woods. But we welcome you nonetheless. We've prepared food and shelter for you. You can stay for as long as you wish.]

Stone Henge hunter: [Thank you, priest. We will stay here for tonight then leave by morning.]

ant hill good 10.title: Ant Hill Underground
ant hill good 10.text:
Lucid visits you.

Lucid: [I think it's time for me to leave. I will leave tomorrow with the Stone Henge hunters.]

Cobby: [Lucid... I haven't thanked you enough for your service to all of us. If there's anything you need, please let me know.]

Lucid: [No, like I always said, it's my wish to help the good people of the frontier.]

Cobby turns to you.

Cobby: [Also... I think you should go with Lucid to Stone Henge and personally return the priest sigil to the priest of Stone Henge. I'm glad that you saved our priest, but it is still wrong.]

ant hill good 11.title: Ant Hill Underground
ant hill good 11.text: The next morning, you leave Ant Hill with Lucid and the hunters of Stone Henge.

ant hill good 12.title: Ant Hill Underground
ant hill good 12.text:
You arrive in Stone Henge.

Lucid: [I'm going to find Pemmi and ask her to come live in Jericho with me. We should meet up in the tavern before I leave.]

You agree.
Lucid moves on to the guard dormitories and you move on to the temple.

Stone Henge Priest: [Oh, hello!]

ant hill good 13.title: Ant Hill Underground
ant hill good 13.text:
Priest: [Oh... Thank you. I thought I had lost this a while ago. I had my mistakes, and you had yours. Did you come all the way to Stone Henge to deliver this? Thank you again.]

You leave the temple and head to the Dolomite tavern.

You spot Lucid sitting alone, drinking.

Lucid: [Oh? Yes, I've decided to leave alone. It was good knowing you. Come visit Jericho sometime.]

He doesn't seem to want to talk anymore.
You leave the tavern to look for Pemmi.

As you take the stairs down, you hear Pemmi talking.

Pemmi: [Oh, Cheese, are you heading back to the woods?]

Cheese: [Of course. I'm going to burn down every single nest these ugly spiders have.]

Pemmi: [Be careful!]

Cheese: [Don't worry. They scramble away like children when I float near. What are they gonna do, throw rocks at me?]

Pemmi: [I love you.]

Cheese: [Love you too. I'll be back.]

You hear them kissing.

You flee back to Ant Hill in terror.
